round: R5 (matched-condition audit of the frozen v4 = REPRISE / CLAVIS-M3)

frozen_method.note: v4 is not modified in R5. Re-implementations in vins/r5.py are asserted equal to the frozen functions (tests/test_r5.py and r5_eval.py --check-v4).

data_policy.dev_only: All R5 decisions (baseline hyper-parameters, entrance thresholds, method changes) use dev1/dev2 only.
data_policy.test: The OpenOOD test split is not read in R5 until a separate pre-registration for the single final run (Phase 3).

conditions.shot_draws: 5 disjoint 16-shot draws per ImageNet-1K class (12 support + 4 calibration), seeded, excluding every dev1/dev2 image, the TINS 16-shot list, Codex duplicates, sealed images (scripts/r5_shots.py). The same draws serve dev1 and dev2 (their own ID classes).
conditions.tins: Re-run per draw (prototypes, negatives and inversion initialisation rebuilt with the draw's shots by the upstream functions); the stream images and orders are identical across draws and methods.
conditions.reference: draw 'orig' = the shots used during development (reported separately; regression check of the R5 pipeline).

uncertainty: Differences are computed within a condition; each draw contributes the mean over its 3 orders; 95% t interval over the 5 draw means (4 d.o.f.); sign counts reported.

stageA_question.question: Does the entrance + memory add to TINS x label propagation under matched conditions?
stageA_question.comparison: s_full (S * p_t * p_LP, both views) - s_lp (S * p_LP, both views)
stageA_question.criterion: Stable if the 95% interval of the near FPR95 difference is below 0 on both dev1 and dev2; reported with near AUROC and far metrics. Otherwise the added value of the entrance/memory is not established under matched conditions.

baselines_(1).knn: k-th NN cosine distance to the pooled 12-shot support, k in {1,2,3,5,10,20,50}
baselines_(1).mahalanobis_pp: L2-normalised features, class means of the support, shared covariance shrunk (1-l)S + l tr(S)/D I, l in {0, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, 0.1, 0.2, 0.5}
baselines_(1).calibration: the same 4 calibration shots per class; conformal p per view; product over the two views, alone and x TINS (same as REPRISE)
baselines_(1).tuning: hyper-parameter chosen on dev1 by mean near FPR95 (separately for alone and x TINS), frozen, evaluated on dev2
